Done. Wrote `test/test_llms_txt_charset.py` (the only file changed) with `test_llms_txt_content_type_has_exactly_one_charset`, following the repo's existing conventions (`client` fixture, `@pytest.mark.public` marker as used by the sibling `/llms.txt` test).

**Valid RED confirmed.** All earlier assertions pass (200, `"Quantum Bank"`/`"Split.io"` in body, media type `text/plain`), and it fails on exactly the targeted defect:

```
AssertionError: Content-Type contains exactly one charset= token (found 2 in 'text/plain; charset=utf-8; charset=utf-8')
assert 2 == 1
```

The required phrase `Content-Type contains exactly one charset= token` appears both in the assertion source and the failure output. I also verified out-of-repo (no repo files touched) that a bare `text/plain` mimetype yields `text/plain; charset=utf-8` with exactly one charset token, so the test will go GREEN on the intended fix rather than being unsatisfiable. The fix itself is left to the executor.
